explorer.description: Read-only code search and reading; returns findings with file paths

orchestrator.description: Runs one change from brainstorm to archive

executor.description: Implements one task from a brief file

executor-strong.description: Implements one prose-described or escalated task from a brief file

task-reviewer.description: Reviews one task: spec verdict first, quality only when compliant

architect.description: System-level design: ADRs, diagrams, roadmap, proofs of concept, change candidates

harness-builder.description: Measures a service's error background and designs evidence-backed quality gates

instrumentation.description: Builds and audits project agent instrumentation: AGENTS.md, .agents rules, skills and agents

workspace-builder.description: Creates and extends team workspaces from the workspace kit

setup-improver.description: Audits and improves the global OpenCode setup: config drift, upstream sources, flow metrics
